proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.areaOverride relative-area multiplier
proposed_widenings.justification: The item grants an existing spell with a modified area stated relative to that spell's normal area. The current surface only supports absolute replacement shapes, not relative scaling from the granted spell's authored area.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "The web created by the spell fills twice its normal area."

notes: Composite magic-item shape already fits the passive benefits and the once-per-dawn Web cast with fixed DC 13. The only blocking gap is the relative area rider; authoring an absolute area override would be misleading, so no content file was produced.
